rep_monthly.name: Rep monthly
rules: forecast = bookings + plan.commit_weight * commit + plan.best_case_weight * best_case + plan.pipeline_weight * (open_pipeline - commit - best_case)

rep_quarterly.name: Rep quarterly
rules: coverage = IF(gap > 0 and open_pipeline > 0, open_pipeline / gap, BLANK)

commissions.name: Commission by tranche
rules: in_tranche = IF(attainment <= comp_plan.from_pct, 0, IF(attainment >= comp_plan.to_pct, comp_plan.to_pct - comp_plan.from_pct, attainment - comp_plan.from_pct))

payout.name: Variable pay
rules: spiff_deals = COUNT(opps.acv[rep=@rep, won=1, security_addon=1, close_quarter=@quarter]) * quarter.spiff_active
total_variable = IF(uncapped_variable > plan.cap_multiple * target_variable, plan.cap_multiple * target_variable, uncapped_variable)

team.name: Team quarterly (region × segment)
rules: coverage = IF(quota - bookings > 0 and open_pipeline > 0, open_pipeline / (quota - bookings), BLANK)

region_quarterly.name: Region quarterly
rules: coverage = IF(quota - bookings > 0 and open_pipeline > 0, open_pipeline / (quota - bookings), BLANK)

segment_quarterly.name: Segment quarterly
rules: coverage = IF(quota - bookings > 0 and open_pipeline > 0, open_pipeline / (quota - bookings), BLANK)
avg_cycle_days = IFERROR(SUM(opps.cycle_days[segment=@segment, won=1, close_quarter=@quarter]) / COUNT(opps.cycle_days[segment=@segment, won=1, close_quarter=@quarter]), BLANK)

company_quarterly.name: Company quarterly
rules: coverage = IF(gap > 0 and open_pipeline > 0, open_pipeline / gap, BLANK)
avg_cycle_days = IFERROR(SUM(opps.cycle_days[won=1, close_quarter=@quarter]) / COUNT(opps.cycle_days[won=1, close_quarter=@quarter]), BLANK)
